recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle any future ServiceRequest basedOn/replaces alignment under FHIR-54619 or its applied successor, not as a FHIR-40631 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-40631 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R6 asking to add basedOn to VisionPrescription and allow RequestOrchestration as a basedOn reference target for ServiceRequest, VisionPrescription, NutritionOrder, and DeviceRequest.
initial_application: Commit 647632b6786c032fd09b6ee3c70ef9d7c0ba1d3a, merged through PR #3105, added RequestOrchestration to ServiceRequest.basedOn and introduced VisionPrescription.basedOn with the requested targets. Commit 1dc1c4ae89127b3ac2794da0d1d5bf9a8bbf9d5c added RequestOrchestration to NutritionOrder.basedOn. DeviceRequest.basedOn already targeted Reference(Resource) before the FHIR-40631 application, so RequestOrchestration was already allowed there.
additional_context: All four affected resources are active in source/fhir.ini. DeviceRequest's Request-pattern mapping exception documents that DeviceRequest.basedOn is broader than Reference(Request), using Reference(Resource). Pharmacy's MedicationRequest follow-up appears in Applied issues FHIR-40633 and FHIR-41561 and was intentionally scoped to separate Pharmacy work. FHIR-54619 is a later Resolved - change required ServiceRequest alignment issue and was treated as context only.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. ServiceRequest, NutritionOrder, and VisionPrescription explicitly include RequestOrchestration on basedOn, and DeviceRequest's Reference(Resource) target already includes RequestOrchestration without needing a redundant explicit target.
